names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 octombrie.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 7007, «Святитель Иннокентий (Смирнов), епископ Пензенский», with the rank word and the office left off.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 10 октября ст. ст. — «Свт. Иннокентия , епископа Пензенского (1819).»
source.note: No rank is read onto him. His line is the last of the day's first paragraph and carries no icon of its own; the polyeleos a few words before it stands immediately before Ambrose of Optina and is his, and reading it onto the next line would be an inference rather than the source's statement.

attestations.note: This settles what the row said it could not: the Romanian page had the Russian Church recognising him officially in August 2000, and the Russian calendar's own life says the same, «Причислен к лику святых Русской Православной Церкви для общецерковного почитания на Юбилейном Архиерейском Соборе в августе 2000 года». His name page keeps him on this one day, which the life gives as the day of his death: «Святитель скончался 10 октября 1819 года».

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pe 10 octombrie — «Sfântul Inochentie al Penzei»
